text:
maya (PM): Drafting Q3 plan for the Optimize toolkit — proposing an MVP focused on: 1) batching advisor (recommend batch_size + mode), 2) KV/prefix cache suggestions, 3) quantization recommendation checklist, 4) eval-triggered alerts for quality regressions. Hosted + Dedicated first. Need quick scope input from eng/ml/cs.

carly (Eng): Love a lean scope. Can we ship batching heuristics without a full UI? CLI + API for v1.

linh (ML): Eval-triggered alerts need stable eval sets per customer + per-model baselines. Watch out for sampling-induced noise -> false positives.

sam (CS): Customer asks we've heard: per-model quantization guidance (8-bit vs 4-bit tradeoffs) and an expected confidence interval for latency/cost/quality.

diego (ProdOps): Operationally we need rollout gates: canary by customer tier, feature flagging, and automatic fallback to safe defaults. SLA implications for Dedicated customers? :thinking_face:

olga (SRE): KV cache suggestions will require mem quotas + eviction policies. Need to surface cache metrics (hit rate, evictions, avg TTL) in the console.

carly (Eng): Rough estimates: batching advisor + API + basic console summary = ~3 sprints (2 engs). Caching suggestions + metrics = ~2 sprints. Quantization checklist + automated checks = ~1 sprint (ML+eng). Eval-alerting pipeline + alert infra = ~3 sprints (higher uncertainty).

maya (PM): Proposed launch criteria: - batching advisor deployed on hosted and reduces p95 token latency for >=20% sampled requests; - cache metrics and suggestion engine live; - quant checklist published with automated risk warnings; - eval-alerts start notify-only and show <5% false positives during burn-in. Agree or push back?

linh (ML): For the <5% FP target we need to define eval triggers (statistical thresholds). Suggest notify-only for first 6 weeks, then enable actionable roll-forward if stable.

sam (CS): Customers prefer notify-only initially. Also asking for per-route cost impact estimates (so they can plan credits).

diego (ProdOps): Cost-estimate by sampling live traffic is feasible but will add compute. For Dedicated, we can approximate using traffic samples and model perf profiles.

carly (Eng): Agree notify-only. Also recommend de-scoping per-tenant UI for MVP — expose per-tenant via API and a read-only console table later. Saves a sprint.

maya (PM): Decision for MVP: batching advisor (API + console summary), cache suggestions + metrics, quantization checklist + model-specific flags, eval-alerts in notify-only mode. Post-MVP: per-tenant UI, automated rollouts, and tighter integrations. Action items: @carly scope breakdown + eng estimates; @linh eval signals + thresholds; @sam gather top-5 customer asks and examples. :rocket:

eval-bot: Scheduled eval run: optimize/mvp/burnin on 2025-09-15T06:00:00Z.

carly (Eng): I'll post detailed estimates by EOD tomorrow.
